item.text: The starter is minimal, so I’m adding a shared schema and explicit row-to-API mapping first. The server will use short SQLite transactions for idempotent creation, and the worker will claim jobs atomically so the two processes coordinate only through the database.

The core implementation is in place, including persisted retry scheduling and restart recovery. I’m building now, then I’ll exercise both processes against a temporary database and run the repository’s fixed checks.
